detail: We map the process before writing code. Usually a couple of calls and a look at how the work actually happens today, including the parts people have stopped noticing.
A fixed scope and price per phase, in writing, with the assumptions named. If something is uncertain we say so rather than padding the estimate quietly.
You see working software early and often, not a status report. A fixed daily overlap window means questions get answered the same day rather than the next one.

PLACEHOLDER - state the real support commitment. Documentation, access, and whatever period of included support you decide on. This is the step that makes the tagline true, so it needs a real number in it.
